items.headline: Anthropic reveals IPO prospectus as public offering nears

items.headline: Global startup funding hits $159 billion in Q3 2026

items.headline: AI governance startups raise $571 million in early October
items.summary: Twelve AI governance companies raised approximately $571 million by early October 2026. The surge highlights rising demand for compliance and safety tooling.
